About Us

33+ Years Of Industrial Experience

Driven by a skilled and dedicated team, we have built sustained growth and earned the deep trust of our clients across sales, service and calibration. Our state-of-the-art facility features specialized departments for Electric Tools, Pneumatic Tools, Measuring Instruments, Hydraulic Equipment, Machinery, Electrical & Electronics. We extend our sincere gratitude to over 1,500 valued customers— spanning Aerospace, Defense, Automotive, Energy, Textiles, Railways, and Heavy Manufacturing—for their continued partnership and confidence in our expertise.

Quality & Testing

NABL Accredited Calibration Lab

We meet the requirements of ISO/IEC 17025:2017 standards with a team of highly skilled professionals.

  • 01Certified Traceability & AccreditationDelivering NABL-accredited calibration services with full measurement traceability back to national standards to ensure absolute compliance and audit readiness.
  • 02Laboratory Competence (ISO/IEC 17025 : 2017)Operated under strict compliance with ISO/IEC 17025 : 2017, validating our technical proficiency, stringent quality assurance and standardized testing methods.
  • 03Specialized Lab InfrastructureEquipped with dedicated technical units tailored specifically to the nuances of Electrical, Electronic and Precision Measuring equipment.
  • 04On-Site Turnkey ServicingComplete internal servicing and post-repair recalibration for non-conforming equipment, offering complete chain-of-custody control and reduced turn-around times.
